doc.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019

title: Second to Doc Severinsen in network TV gigs
summary: Rowe notes Chez ranks near Doc Severinsen for network TV tenure; Chez mentions other TV band players such as Mark Pender.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Okay so you are, according to what I read you are second place to Doc Severinsen, something about number of gigs.
Network television late night shows perhaps?

TV. Network TV. And there’s been a lot of guys, man. There was a guy from Lawrence Welk, he was on forever. The guys from the Conan band, Conan just got rid of his band, but they were on cable. So that’s Mark Pender. I play in a band with Mark here in New Jersey.
